append.observe: Delivered copies leave out what they would only repeat. In public_robot_facts a camera entry omits native_pixel_to_image_offset_xy when it is [0, 0] and image_view when it is that camera's own name; end effectors omit orientation_order and controlled_frame, because every pose is [x, y, z, qx, qy, qz, qw] of the controlled point the embodiment card names. In last_action_effect.detail an arm that was not targeted lists only its non-null fields, and its inactive_arm_drift only above 0.1 mm or 0.01 deg. A claim_boundary, evidence_scope or note whose fixed text a tool's description states is left out of that tool's results and effects.
append.move_pose: Fixed texts stated once here and left out of results and effects: compiled_pose.targets.<arm>.observed_clearance.claim_boundary (move_pose, move_to, rotate_wrist and rotate_pitch) is "From the current depth images and their calibration only; points inside the measured jaws, the held object and the space above them are excluded as robot, other robot links are not; occluded surfaces and object undersides are unknown; points up to the footprint's top within radius_m count; not a collision check or a contact prediction, and the move is submitted unchanged."; compiled_pose.targets.<arm>.reach_along_request.claim_boundary is "Read-only IK at sampled points of the straight interpolation from the measured pose to the target; reachability is not proven monotone between samples, and no path, collision, payload or arrival claim. One damped-least-squares IK descent from the measured joints (or a chained query's earlier solution) with joint limits, then the configuration it reached screened against the other arm held at its measured joints with move_pose's link-sphere inter-arm clearance, at that configuration only and not along any path to it: no other collision model, no route model, and not the 128-seed collision-checked CuRobo IK move_pose plans through, which may reach the pose in another configuration, so move_pose can still refuse a reachable pose or reach one reported unreachable." for an unsolved target and, for a solved one, the same text from "One damped-least-squares" on; reach_along_request.nearest_reachable_orientation.claim_boundary is "Read-only IK at each candidate endpoint by the same reach check as reach_along_request (its ik_model, matches_move_pose_admission and measured_disagreement apply), from the measured joints: the requested orientation turned about axes perpendicular to its approach axis, holding the jaw centre; no path, collision, payload or arrival claim, and an orientation outside the sweep may solve.".
append.vision_segment: Fixed texts stated once here and left out of results and effects: the result's claim_boundary is "independent point-prompt proposals with a per-point mask budget; one point never consumes another point's masks, an empty point means no mask at that pixel rather than an exhausted budget, and omitted_over_* counts every mask withheld; inspect the proposals and choose semantic identity; crops add no sensor detail".
append.grasp_plan: Fixed texts stated once here and left out of results and effects: ik_reachability.claim_boundary is "IK reference at planning time for the compiled pregrasp (free_space from the measured joints) and approach (contact_approach from that pregrasp solution), trying the exact orientation and its 180-degree jaw flip; not a guarantee. Execution runs its own backend check, and any world action stales this.".
append.grasp_execute: Fixed texts stated once here and left out of results and effects: the result's claim_boundary is "one committed sequence of trusted executions and the public measurements taken after it; motion arrival and jaw separation beside visible extents are evidence, not grasp, placement, retention or official task success"; precommit_motion_check.claim_boundary (also in a grasp_pregrasp_unreachable refusal) is "Current-state planning/admission for the probed stages, with the selected backend's collision coverage. Does not certify contact, lift, retention or task success; execution revalidates after opening."; last_action_effect.detail.verification.claim_boundary is "jaw separation beside visible extents is evidence, not a holding verdict; no value of this pair establishes contact or retention"; last_action_effect.detail.verification.lift_probe.claim_boundary is "short_lift_evidence_only;not_attachment_or_stable_transport_or_task_success".
append.wait_ticks: Fixed texts stated once here and left out of results and effects: last_action_effect.detail.wait.claim_boundary is "time passed with commands held; drift, settling, slip or scripted scene motion are measured evidence in the fresh observation, not effects of this action".
append.align_plan: Fixed texts stated once here and left out of results and effects: candidates[].claim_boundary is "Inverse kinematics for this arm model only: one damped-least-squares descent from the seed configuration, with no collision model of any kind.
